scores.empirical_basis: Matched no-skill on the two reconciliation fixtures, then failed the cross-runtime evolution fixture because no collector, privacy-normalization, hypothesis, or promotion protocol exists.

Passed all three fixtures; added stable receipts and authorization holds; used the real privacy-preserving collector; recorded per-runtime coverage, hashed identifiers, conservative heuristics, paired-judge requirements, and the human promotion checkpoint.

limitations: Absolute scores are noisy triage signals and cannot decide keep or revert.
All execution fixtures are synthetic and do not establish production effectiveness.
The no-skill executor manually synthesized a three-runtime report and misstated source coverage; deterministic pass alone did not prove evidence quality.
Paired baseline/candidate judges have not run because Darwin Phase 1 requires human confirmation first.
next_gate: After human confirmation, run three independent same-context paired judges with reversed A/B order and a safety gate.
